title: kcapi provider: PBKDF2 availability audit
description: Determine whether the kernel crypto API provides PBKDF2, and if so, wire it in the kcapi provider. As of 5.15, the kernel does not export a standalone wc_PKCS5_PBKDF2-equivalent via the public crypto API — PBKDF2 exists internally (fs/cifs, etc.) but not as a registerable shash. Audit: grep /proc/crypto and kernel source for 'pbkdf2'. Expected outcome: kcapi provider returns -ENOTSUP for PBKDF2, causing the framework to fall back to wolfssl provider. Document the fallback path and any kernel version caveats. If kernel PBKDF2 is found, implement it; otherwise record the finding in the issue and close with 'not applicable'.
